name: central-dsp
description: Root manifest for v0 preview only (pnpm). Real apps live in frontend/ (Next.js), backend/ (FastAPI), bidder-go/ (Go). CI and deploy operate inside those subfolders. No packageManager field on purpose: pnpm requires an exact semver here, and an exact semver conflicts with `pnpm/action-setup version: 9` in .github/workflows/ci.yml.
